notes.claim: To change a decimal to a percentage, multiply by 100, and a fraction such as part over whole becomes a percentage when multiplied by 100.
A motor's efficiency is its power output divided by its power input, usually expressed as a percentage.
A resistor's tolerance is its deviation from the nominal value in percent, so a 1 kΩ resistor with a 10% tolerance could be anywhere from 900 Ω to 1.1 kΩ.

sources.title: What is a percentage? - BBC Bitesize
sources.quote: To change a decimal to a percentage, multiply by 100

sources.title: Percentage change - BBC Bitesize
sources.quote: To convert a fraction to a percentage, either use equivalent fractions to make the denominator 100, or multiply the fraction by 100.

sources.title: Electric Motors: Energy Efficiency Reference Guide - Natural Resources Canada
sources.quote: The efficiency of a motor is the ratio of mechanical power output to the electrical power input and is usually expressed as a percentage.

sources.title: Estimating Motor Efficiency in the Field — U.S. Department of Energy
sources.quote: Efficiency is defined as output power divided by input power.

sources.title: ResistoRs 101 — Vishay
sources.quote: Resistor tolerance is expressed as the deviations from nominal value in percent and is typically measured at 25 °C.

sources.title: Topic 3 - Resistors & Resistor circuits (notes).pdf — Imperial College London
sources.quote: Let us suppose you have a 1kΩ resistor with a tolerance of 10%. This resistor could vary from 900Ω to 1.1kΩ in value.
